limitations: Source PASS establishes no execution permission; root authorization and monitor are excluded. Actual remote stage/launch, interpreter/environment behavior and physical cost were not exercised.
RSS and GPU headroom are sampled. Per-process PyTorch allocator fraction applies to PyTorch-managed device memory; it is not an instantaneous device-wide isolation guarantee.
Completion can measure one co-resident TRAIN epoch per arm only. It supplies no VALID/TEST prediction, full500-epoch feasibility, dedicated80GiB feasibility, novelty or acceptance evidence.
Native target receipt hashing and runtime synchronization enter the measured workload; per-update wall times exclude epoch setup/negative-draw work, which is included in epoch time.
The general receipt validator allows CPU-only RNG objects for CPU producers; the actual reviewed CUDA producer writes both CPU and current-device CUDA digests.

resolved_findings.evidence: Required common and auxiliary receipt keys are schema-validated before cross-arm comparison; jointly missing keys, malformed digests/types/counts, invalid JSON and drifting hashes make pairing ineligible. Producer repeats initial parameter and epoch negative draw digests on every update. Existing13 regressions pass.
Both drivers require --output-dir. The stdlib guard admits only new absolute writable project paths outside every sealed source tree; default output_dir is null.
Initial client indexed files only. Reviewed client accepts exactly one of files or payloads and verifies every row; corrected candidate stage is compatible.

root_supervision_assessment.signaling: Exact held direct-child original process group only; no broad/global GPU signaling. waitid WNOWAIT retains identity until physical session closure and direct-child reap; unresolved cleanup is failed.

runtime_entrypoint_assessment.TRAIN_VALID_load_note: The qualified combined dataset artifact is loaded and its fixed VALID tensors are structurally validated by the inherited loader; runtime never calls validate, scores VALID, or uses VALID for teacher or training.

scope: Fresh bounded technical source review of immutable v2 receipt/path repairs, one actual complete TRAIN epoch entrypoint, and two root runtime client/supervisor scripts. No manuscript or acceptance review.
